summary: Full-stack testing of NEXORA (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). All 12 backend pytest cases passed and all 10 critical frontend flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (375x667).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: `useNativeDriver` is not supported on web — falls back to JS animation. Non-blocking on web preview but worth confirming set to false in web build.
Console deprecation warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Migrate to style.pointerEvents in the components that still use the top-level prop.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace `pointerEvents` prop with `style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}` to silence RN deprecation warning.
Optional: set useNativeDriver:false for web animations to avoid warning noise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/users returns 200 OK; convention prefers 201 Created (non-blocking).
discover() uses recursion on race-condition; safe due to weighted pick but could be a bounded loop for clarity.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection everywhere.
seed_data_creation: Test users 'TEST_Ada', 'TEST_Discoverer', 'TEST_UI_Ada' were created for testing. Discoveries incremented shared relic counts (e.g., genesis=1, alfalium=3 after runs). Non-destructive to catalog.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 10 relic keys, testIDs, and endpoints are verified. Registry counts persist across runs since MongoDB is shared. `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) is the correct env var in this project. Tests are runnable via: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v

frontend: home shows greeting + empty CTA + 4 tiles
registry-row-genesis...omeguium in correct rarity order with '0 / N' style
profile shows name/city/country/stats + rarest card + invites/settings links
